headline: Karnataka Flags Petrol Samples Exceeding Permissible 20% Ethanol Blend Limit
summary: Tests in Karnataka detected ethanol levels up to 31.2 percent in petrol samples, raising vehicle mileage concerns among consumers.
why: Ethanol blending mandates affect fuel supply chains, automobile engines, and oil marketing companies operating in India.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Excess ethanol content in fuel impacts retail petroleum compliance and vehicle efficiency.
